text: Happening, in that season, to be in the country, on a clear and calm night, I laid a thermometer upon dewy grass, and suspended a second, in the air, two feet above the other. An hour afterwards, the thermometer on the grass was found to be 8° lower, by Fahrenheit’s division, than the one in the air.
